name: Taco Bell Quesadilla, Cheesy Roll-Up & Pintos
whyItWorks: Soft flour tortillas and pureed pintos avoid the sharp corn hulls and raw lettuce of standard tacos.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Cheese or Chicken Quesadilla (no creamy jalapeno sauce if flaring), Cheesy Roll-Up, or Pintos & Cheese stirred smooth (no red strips or pico).
